hints.title: Ordered Children Adjacency
hints.text: Represent royal family relations as an adjacency list where children are appended in chronological birth order.

hints.title: Tombstone Deletion
hints.text: Record deceased individuals in a dead set without deleting their subtree nodes.

hints.title: Preorder DFS Traversal
hints.text: Traverse family members using preorder depth-first search, appending alive members to the succession order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total number of persons created
complexity.notes: Birth and death operations execute in O(1) time; inheritance order traverses the N-ary tree in linear O(N) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding the entire succession tree on each death or birth incurs quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tombstone deletion avoids subtree relocations at the cost of checking set membership during preorder traversal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Preorder DFS traversal of an N-ary hierarchy combined with tombstone set filtering.
